description: Animate a variable font's weight/width axes on a text layer via a new Text Animator
notes: Variable font axes are added via animatorProps.addVariableFontAxis(tag) (AE 26.0+), never addProperty("ADBE Text VF Axis N") -- AE throws "Can not add a property" for the latter. The returned property holds the axis's ABSOLUTE value (e.g. wght 100-900), not an offset. Fully keyframe each axis before adding the next -- addProperty/addVariableFontAxis invalidates prior sibling references in the same group. ALWAYS clamp keyframe values to the font's real fontObject.designAxesData [min,max] -- a naive target*0.5 guess (e.g. width 100 -> 50) can fall below the font's actual floor (e.g. wdth min 75), writing an invalid design-space coordinate; AE has crashed scrubbing/editing such a keyframe (verified empirically, 2026-07-21). Also skip adding a second 'Variable Font Axes' animator if one already exists -- stacking duplicates is never the intent.
